# Ownership is compulsory for the entire marked-function dependency graph.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -gcflags=all=-d=isolateheap=0 -o owned$GOEXE ./host
exec ./owned$GOEXE
stdout '^default ownership enforced$'

[race] exec ./owned-race$GOEXE
[race] stdout '^default ownership enforced$'

stderr 'isolate: source cannot link to privileged operation runtime.isolateEnterMetadata'

# A module cannot impersonate a GOROOT metadata callback through its name.
# Raw hooks here model the audited service; they are deliberately unavailable
# to the marked workflow above.
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -gcflags=example.org/isolateownership/callbackdispatch=-d=isolateeffects=1 -o callback-check$GOEXE ./callbackhost
exec ./callback-check$GOEXE
stdout '^metadata namespace denied$'

-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import (
 "context"
 "math"
 "net/textproto"
 "fmt"
 "reflect"
 "regexp"
 "runtime/metrics"
 "sync/atomic"
 "isolate"
)
var counter = 41
// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Probe(mode byte) (string,error) {
 if mode == 1 { return textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey("content-type"),nil }
 if mode == 2 { fmt.Print("forbidden private output"); return "unexpected",nil }
 counter++
 if math.Exp(0) != 1 { panic("math initialization changed") }
 descriptions := metrics.All()
 if len(descriptions) == 0 || descriptions[0].Name == "" { panic("metric descriptions changed") }
 descriptions[0].Name = "private description"
 // A nil defer is registered successfully and panics only on invocation.
 reached := false
 func() {
  defer func() { if recover() == nil || !reached { panic("nil defer behavior changed") } }()
  var fn func()
  defer fn()
  reached = true
 }()
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 cancel()
 if ctx.Err() != context.Canceled { panic("context cancellation changed") }
 var value atomic.Value
 value.Store("owned")
 if value.Swap("next") != "owned" || !value.CompareAndSwap("next", "last") { panic("atomic value changed") }
 record := reflect.StructOf([]reflect.StructField{{Name:"Text", Type:reflect.TypeFor[string](), Tag:`json:"text"`}})
 field := record.Field(0)
 if field.Name != "Text" || string(field.Tag) != `json:"text"` { panic("type fields changed") }
 fn := reflect.FuncOf([]reflect.Type{record}, []reflect.Type{record}, false)
 if fn.In(0) != record || fn.Out(0) != record { panic("type signature changed") }
 left, right := reflect.New(record).Elem(), reflect.New(record).Elem()
 left.Field(0).SetString("text")
 right.Field(0).SetString("text")
 if left.Interface() != right.Interface() { panic("constructed equality changed") }
 mapType := reflect.MapOf(record, reflect.TypeFor[string]())
 values := reflect.MakeMap(mapType)
 values.SetMapIndex(left, reflect.ValueOf("mapped"))
 if values.MapIndex(right).String() != "mapped" { panic("constructed map changed") }
 if !regexp.MustCompile("^last$").MatchString(value.Load().(string)) { panic("regexp changed") }
 return fmt.Sprintf("state:%d", counter),nil
}
func Plain() string { result,err := Probe(0); if err != nil { panic(err) }; return result }
func Program(h isolate.Handle) isolate.Program {
 return h.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
  input, err := isolate.Call(1,nil)
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
  err = h.Invoke(func(args ...isolate.Value) error { *args[0].Pointer.(*byte) = input[0]; return nil },
   func(results ...isolate.Value) error { _, err := isolate.Call(2, []byte(results[0].Value.(string))); return err })
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
 })
}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "time"
 "example.org/isolateownership/jobs"
)
func main() {
 if jobs.Plain() != "state:42" { panic("host state") }
 now := time.Date(2025,time.January,2,0,0,0,0,time.UTC)
 handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Probe)
 if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
 for _, deterministic := range []bool{false,true} {
  for _, mode := range []byte{0,0,1,2} {
   instance,err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: jobs.Program(handle), Deterministic:deterministic, InitialTime:&now, TimerOp:9})
   if err != nil { panic(err) }
   if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
   select {
   case command := <-instance.Commands(): command.Reply([]byte{mode},nil)
   case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
   }
   if mode == 0 {
    select {
    case command := <-instance.Commands():
     if string(command.Payload) != "state:42" { panic("instance state") }
     command.Reply(nil,nil)
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    if err := instance.Wait(); err != nil { panic(err) }
   } else {
    var fault *isolate.OwnershipError
    err := instance.Wait()
    if mode == 1 && !errors.As(err,&fault) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("process state allowed: %v",err)) }
    if mode == 2 && err == nil { panic("private output was allowed") }
   }
   ctx,cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),time.Second)
   err = instance.Kill(ctx)
   cancel()
   if err != nil { panic(err) }
  }
 }
 if jobs.Plain() != "state:43" { panic("host state changed") }
 fmt.Println("default ownership enforced")
}
-- badlink/main.go --
package main
import _ "unsafe"
//go:linkname enter runtime.isolateEnterMetadata
func enter() uintptr
// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Probe() { enter() }
func main() {}

-- fake/callback/callback.go --
package callback
var Called bool
func Callback() { Called = true; panic("untrusted callback executed") }
func Generic[T any]() { Callback() }
-- callbackhost/main.go --
package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "strings"
 "unsafe"
 "internal/fake/callback"
 "example.org/isolateownership/callbackdispatch"
)
//go:linkname newGroup runtime.isolateNewGroup
func newGroup() unsafe.Pointer
//go:linkname setGroup runtime.isolateSetGroup
func setGroup(unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer
//go:linkname setOwner runtime.isolateSetOwner
func setOwner(uintptr) uintptr
//go:linkname enter runtime.isolateEnterMetadata
func enter() uintptr
//go:linkname leave runtime.isolateLeaveMetadata
func leave(uintptr)
func main() {
 // Host calls retain ordinary behavior outside a service scope.
 func() { defer func() { if recover() != "untrusted callback executed" { panic("host callback changed") } }(); callback.Callback() }()
 callback.Called = false
 for mode := 0; mode < 4; mode++ {
  func() {
   group := setGroup(newGroup())
   previous := setOwner(7101)
   defer setGroup(group)
   defer setOwner(previous)
   var failure any
   var owner uintptr
   func() {
    // Recovery belongs to this deliberately privileged fixture and is
    // registered before entering the service. No callback is recorded inside
    // the service until the instrumented dispatcher validates its target.
    defer func() { failure = recover() }()
    owner = enter()
    switch mode {
    case 0: callbackdispatch.Invoke(callback.Callback)
    case 1: callbackdispatch.Deferred(callback.Callback)
    case 2: callbackdispatch.PanicDeferred(callback.Callback)
    case 3: callbackdispatch.Invoke(callback.Generic[int])
    }
   }()
   leave(owner)
   message,ok := failure.(string)
   if !ok || !strings.HasPrefix(message,"isolate: forbidden operation unaudited metadata callback internal/fake/callback.") { panic("untrusted callback accepted") }
  }()
  if callback.Called { panic("untrusted callback executed in service") }
 }
 fmt.Println("metadata namespace denied")
}

-- callbackdispatch/dispatch.go --
package callbackdispatch
//go:noinline
func Invoke(fn func()) { fn() }
//go:noinline
func Deferred(fn func()) { defer fn() }
//go:noinline
func PanicDeferred(fn func()) { defer fn(); panic("force unwind") }
